Travel to <DST> in the <DSY> system, land there to pickup the <CT>, and return to ConEx. You have one month to complete this mission and it pays 20,000 credits. In this mission, you will have to avoid, outrun, or destroy the Academy training ships. Their weapons will not harm your ship, but they will provide a realistic simulation of combat. By this time, you should have enough money to purchase an Afterburner. This device will allow you to escape dangerous situations by allowing your ship to reach high speeds. Before you leave Levo, we suggest you visit the "Outfit Ship" area and purchase an afterburner. To use it, press "z". Your ship will speed up in the direction you are pointing. Remember, our overseer will accompany you. Hail him if you need help.
